# NIDO Research Institute (Nido Montessori School & Blue Blocks School)

> NIDO Research Institute is the dedicated pedagogical and developmental research arm of Nido Montessori Preschool (Bachupally, Hyderabad) in collaboration with Blue Blocks Complete Montessori School (Gachibowli/Tellapur, Hyderabad). We conduct embedded, naturalistic, longitudinal research investigating child development, Montessori pedagogy, cognitive agency, executive function, and human potential from infancy through adolescence.

## Core Institutional Information
- Organization: Nido Research Institute / Nido Montessori School
- Associated Campus: Blue Blocks Complete Montessori School (Gachibowli, Tellapur, Hyderabad)
- Location: Plot No. 405, Block 19, Lahari Green Park Road, Bowrampet, Bachupally, Hyderabad, Telangana 500043, India (Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/naRP5GC3BFH92j5v6 | Coordinates: 17.553145, 78.3838549)
- Website: https://research.nidomontessori.in/

- Accreditations: Association Montessori Internationale (AMI) Standards, International Montessori Foundation (IMF) Flagship School

## Research Domains & Focus Areas
1. Spatial Cognition & Sensorimotor Geometry: Tracking how manipulation of sensorial Montessori materials builds mathematical intuition and spatial reasoning.
2. Self-Regulation & Deep Concentration Cycles: Longitudinal analysis of 3-hour uninterrupted Montessori work periods on executive function and attentional endurance.
3. Language Acquisition & Phonetic Exploration: How tactile Sandpaper Letters and movable alphabets accelerate multilingual literacy and vocabulary mastery.
4. Mathematical Reasoning & Concrete Abstraction: Empirical progression from concrete golden bead quantities to abstract algebraic operations.
5. Agency, Independence & Practical Life: Developing executive autonomy through purposeful motor tasks and self-directed activity.
6. Social Development in Mixed-Age Cohorts: Peer mentorship, spontaneous empathy, conflict resolution, and leadership dynamics across 3-year age spans.
7. Movement, Vestibular Integration & Physical Agency: Correlation between gross/fine motor freedom and neurodevelopmental readiness.
8. Emotional Regulation & Classroom Normalization: The transition from dysregulated energy to joyful, focused purpose in prepared environments.

## Featured Research Publications & Manuscripts
- Building a Montessori School from the Ground Up: An Observational Case Study of the Founding Phases of Nido Montessori Preschool, Bachupally (by Shobha Goyal, DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.nido.2026.01, ORCID: 0009-0004-8823-119X): Comprehensive 30-page longitudinal empirical case study documenting the 5 founding phases (Conceptualization, Site Construction & Registration, Prepared Environment & Sourcing, Human Environment Recruitment & AMI Training, Community Outreach & Admissions). Full text available at https://research.nidomontessori.in/research-studies/building-a-montessori-school-from-the-ground-up-case-study
- Play-Based Learning & Executive Function in Early Childhood: Longitudinal analysis of Montessori structured self-chosen work on working memory and inhibitory control.
- Independence in Action: A Montessori Perspective: Naturalistic observational research on early autonomy and problem-solving confidence.
- The Role of Mixed-Age Classrooms in Social Development: Peer scaffolding and prosocial behavior in 3-to-6 year multi-age communities.
